selection_rule: All matching original Keyword cells, in source order; no truncation or quota.
normalization: Unchanged tools/keyword-system/keyword_audit.py normalize(original_literal); normalized text never replaces the original cell.
literal_hash_definition: SHA256 of exact original Keyword UTF-8 bytes, without a newline.
review_method: Manual complete-literal semantic review of this fixed 402-row partition, read in five bounded batches of 80, 80, 80, 80 and 82 phrases. Source seeds and metrics were not intent evidence. Dispositions were assigned after reading every owned literal.
